item: Self-update offers release tags only: no fallback to main's tip, a plain no-release answer, and every non-tag ref refused at the apply, the spawn and the helper
summary: With no vX.Y.Z tag the check offered main's tip and the helper fetched refs/heads/main. The check now reads the tags list only; no tag answers no_release and Settings says no release has been published (x12); a tags page that is not a list is a read failure. validate_apply, launch_helper and the helper's apply each refuse any ref that is not a vX.Y.Z tag, failing closed (a plan of kind main, no kind, or a non-string ref or sha is bad_plan). Tag and sha patterns are ASCII-only with no trailing newline; the manual steps merge the newest release tag. Two security reads, their findings applied. Red before: the fallback, a non-tag ref at validate_apply, the helper plan, a failed later page, the manual steps.
